notes.title: Glitchhikers Second Anniversary Patch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379897/d4c9afe89e6d0871047d21b3a8965c19a66f2bd2.png[/img]

Happy April Fools Day, to one and all—or as we'd like to rename it, "The Fool's Day." This is not a trick and we have no desire to deceive! In 2024 our communities do not need a special day to celebrate social deception. So instead of delighting in corporations blatantly lying to you, albeit with a little more twinkle in their eye than usual, let's celebrate the positive aspects of foolishness!

In tarot, the fool is a special and significant card. It marks the beginning of an epic journey, when all things are still possible. It also signifies a beginner's mind, in which the humble acknowledgement of ignorance allows for openness, eagerness, and a lack of preconceptions. Every day we all are fools in many ways and in many subjects, and we are all fools at the mercy of modern systems beyond our total comprehension.

And of course, this also marks the 2-year anniversary of the release of Glitchhikers! Thank you for being with us on this amazing journey—the game continues to get better in small and subtle ways based on player feedback. Our achievement hunters were suffering as they tried to find every single character in the game, so we've made some changes to the way the hikers spawn that will [b]much more strongly favour new encounters[/b] until they have all been exhausted through repeated journeys. If you’re just missing a few hikers, or if you’re starting the game for the first time, this new patch should help ensure more varied and unseen parts of the game!

(If you’re still having trouble finding certain hikers to fill out your Cool Zone, be sure to check out [url=glitchhikers.com/cool-zone]our full hiker breakdown on the Glitchhikers website,[/url] which lays out which hikers can be found where, and whether they have certain conditions before appearing in the game.)

Thanks again for being with us these last two years. May we all be the fool today and open our minds to new experiences and journeys, together.

[h3]Full Patch Notes[/h3]
1.0.9
General:
- Greatly increases the chance of spawning hikers that have not yet been encountered on a given journey

notes.title: Glitchhikers First Anniversary Celebration!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379897/6ee2e592054cae6c50ba9e81e9cf9cbcb13acf92.png[/img]

Hello to our fellow hikers, dreamers, and stargazers. It seems almost impossible to believe, but we’ve reached the first anniversary of Glitchhikers: The Spaces Between!  

Today's celebration is packed with exciting surprises for Glitchhikers fans. Firstly, we are thrilled to announce that a new patch for the game is now available, bringing several quality of life improvements that will enhance your gaming experience. See the full patch below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379897/43c95480246181f7f29f2fc0c30a36aad04ce955.png[/img]
In addition to this, we have also updated our website, glitchhikers.com, adding a Cool Zone section with details about every single hiker you can encounter in the game. There’s a little information about each, along with exactly where and how each hiker can be found in the game. If you’re trying to complete your own Cool Zone, or are interested in how exactly our content filters affect hiker appearances, this is the perfect resource for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379897/857c77b415ad94e9ff7168d992ee402c748c3038.png[/img]

But wait, there's more! We're also releasing a Glitchhikers: The Spaces Between “B-Side & Extras” EP with nine all-new songs and variations (because in the eyes of our Lead Composer, Devin Vibert, our 71-song Deluxe Soundtrack was feeling a little light).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379897/722c025cbeb7e6b599f161827cec91ca637cf595.png[/img]

For more of a Glitchhikers music fix, we have a special livestream over on Twitch tonight hosted by Claris Cyarron, our Creative Director and Glitchhikers Co-composer. The Glitchhikers Anniversary Synth Jam will be a chill, musical, hangout where we can reflect on the last year, and watch Claris play with her pet synths and Glitchhikers Videopak. To get in the mood, you can also check out her Glitchhikers Anniversary Playlist, or check out the never-before-released Glitchhikers Suite Live Performance by the UBC Orchestra from Games in Music last year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379897/ff38db1ffd5046a83df0db83dd853fcc0875b9d2.png[/img]
To top it all off, we're thrilled to announce that this is the biggest sale in Glitchhikers history, with a whopping 35% off! It's the perfect time to dive into the game and immerse yourself in the world of Glitchhikers. 

You can read more about this [url=silverstringmedia.com/news/2023/3/30/glitchhikers-1st-anniversary-celebration-amp-interview-with-lucas-jw-johnson-and-audrey-storey]in our Anniversary blog post,[/url] which also features an interview between Double Jump and two of the founding Glitchhikers creators, Studio Director Lucas J.W. Johnson and Technical Director Audrey Storey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379897/3c59e4ea3008940adec7263d13932f9e51aec7b0.png[/img]
[h3]Full Patch Notes[/h3]
1.0.7
General:
- Improvements to the Sliders in the Pause Menu
- Improvements to the Dropdowns in the Pause Menu
- Updated credits
- Fixed various minor Pause Menu bugs

The Hub:
- Added a short description of each journey that appears when starting them
- Added a toggle to the menu to turn off the above feature
- The Path and The Terminal now unlock just by starting The Railway or The Highway rather than needing to complete one of them

The Highway:
- Improved the consistency of the interaction that begins Hiker conversations

notes.title: Notes from the Glitchscape
notes.content:
1.0.4 Patch Notes

General
Players may now skip the credits by pressing any button five seconds after the credits begin
Added English subtitles for “Circles”
Fixed an issue with z-fighting on the Maze portal
Fixed an issue with localization loading on non-english operating systems
Fixed an issue where the options panels could add duplicate settings
Fixed a few memory leaks

The Path
Fixed an issue where the spacebar would stop emitting input after quitting out of The Path’s tutorial
Fixed an issue where the park map flow could break when navigating between nodes when exiting the map
Hotfixed an issue with blinks locking up while using the park map

The Railway
Fixed an issue with one hiker’s camera not triggering in the ending sequence

The Terminal
Fixed a flow issue with one conversation

The Stop
Fixed an issue where one of the Coolzone’s drink boxes did not match the Hiker’s art
